front: Helm: chart vs release vs revision
back: Chart = package of templates + values. Release = one installation of a chart under a name. Revision = numbered version of a release created by each install, upgrade or rollback.

front: Idempotent Helm deploy command for CI

back: Chart `values.yaml` < parent chart values < `-f` files in order given < `--set`/`--set-string`/`--set-file`.
`helm list -A`, `helm status`, `helm history`, `helm get values [--all]`, `helm get manifest`, `helm rollback <rel> <rev>`.
Both render a named template, but `include` returns a string you can pipe (`| nindent 4`), so it is preferred.

front: Why must Deployment selector labels be stable?
back: `spec.selector` is immutable. If it contains a changing value (version), upgrades fail with `field is immutable`. Use name + instance only.

front: Helm trick to restart pods when a ConfigMap changes
How do you validate a chart before deploying?
back: `helm lint --strict`, `helm template ... | kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f -` (or `helm install --dry-run=server`), `helm test` after install, `ct`/helm-unittest in CI.

front: Push a chart to an OCI registry
back: `helm package ./chart` then `helm push chart-0.1.0.tgz oci://registry/path` (after `helm registry login`). Install with `helm install rel oci://registry/path/chart --version 0.1.0`.

front: Kustomize: what does a generator's hash suffix achieve?
back: A changed ConfigMap/Secret gets a new name, and references are rewritten, so Deployments roll automatically and old pods keep the old config.

front: Kustomize: modern fields replacing deprecated ones
back: `labels` replaces `commonLabels`; `patches` replaces `patchesStrategicMerge` and `patchesJson6902`. Run `kustomize edit fix` to migrate.
Declarative, versioned and immutable, pulled automatically, continuously reconciled.

front: Argo CD: sync status vs health status
back: Sync: does live state match Git (Synced/OutOfSync)? Health: are resources working (Healthy/Progressing/Degraded/Missing)? They are independent.
Prune deletes live resources that were removed from Git. Self-heal re-syncs when live state drifts from Git (e.g. after kubectl edit).

ApplicationSet generates many Applications from one template plus generators (list, cluster, git directories). App-of-apps is an Application whose manifests are other Applications, used to bootstrap a cluster.
